run.summary:
Hey EHC fam! 🚀

Just wanted to say I'm absolutely stoked about what we pulled off today. Taking that level 9 planet was no small feat, and I'm genuinely proud of how we all came together to make it happen.

And the cherry on top? I got awarded Prince! 🏆 Huge thanks to every single one of you for the support, the coordination, and the grind. This is what EHC is all about.

Let's keep this momentum going. On to the next one! 💪

— Your favorite Prince 👑
